name: Sherwin-Williams
description: Sherwin-Williams is mainly a paint retailer that owns its manufacturing: its Paint Stores Group runs 4,853 company-operated specialty stores in the US, Canada and the Caribbean that sell Sherwin-Williams and other controlled-brand paint to professional contractors and do-it-yourself homeowners, and that segment made $13.6B of $23.6B FY2025 sales and 68% of segment profit. Consumer Brands sells paint and stains (Valspar, Dutch Boy, Minwax, Krylon, Suvinil) to home centers, hardware stores and dealers. Performance Coatings sells industrial, automotive refinish, protective and marine coatings worldwide to manufacturers and body shops. Money comes from paint sold through its own stores to contractors and homeowners, plus paint and coatings sold to retailers and industrial customers. In October 2025 it bought Suvinil, a Brazilian paint maker with about $525M of annual sales.

sub.name: Home improvement, building products and timber

gics.note: Conventional filing: sector and sub-industry from Wikipedia's List of S&P 500 companies (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_S%26P_500_companies, read 2026-09-30); industry group and industry not on that page, so null. EDGAR SIC 5200 (Retail-Building Materials, Hardware, Garden Supply), the largest segment is a 4,853-store retail chain: 4,853 company-operated paint stores produce 58% of sales.

hq.note: EDGAR business address and Wikipedia S&P 500 list both Cleveland, OH

businessLines.name: Paint Stores Group
businessLines.how: Professional painting and industrial contractors and homeowners buy paint, stains and supplies at the company's own stores, buying repeatedly; revenue follows repaint and new-construction activity, price increases and store count.
businessLines.description: 4,853 company-operated specialty paint stores (206 owned) in the US, Canada and the Caribbean at 2025-12-31, selling Sherwin-Williams and other controlled-brand architectural paint and coatings, protective and marine products and related items; 80 net new stores opened in 2025.

operatingProfit.note: Segment profit; FY2024 $2,902.6M (+5.5%), margin 22.0%. Share is of the three segments' $4,513.8M (sum computed) before Administrative costs of $1,175.6M. Net sales +3.2%; H1 2026 net sales $6,939.9M vs $6,642.0M.

businessLines.name: Consumer Brands Group
businessLines.how: Retail chains and dealers buy cans and applicators to stock shelves (including private-label paint made for retailers); revenue depends on retailer orders, do-it-yourself demand and pricing, and the Latin American stores sell directly to customers.
businessLines.description: Branded and private-label architectural paint, stains, varnishes, wood finishes, applicators, aerosols, caulks and adhesives sold to home centers, hardware stores, dedicated dealers and distributors in North America, Latin America and Europe; also 307 company-operated paint stores in Latin America (Mexico 190, Chile 47, Ecuador 33, Brazil and others). Includes Suvinil (Brazil) since October 2025.

operatingProfit.note: Segment profit; FY2024 $589.9M (-13.6%), margin 19.0%. Q2 2026 net sales $983.5M vs $809.4M (Suvinil acquisition); H1 2026 $1,891.8M vs $1,571.6M.

businessLines.name: Performance Coatings Group
businessLines.how: Manufacturers, auto body shops and industrial and marine owners buy coatings repeatedly for use in production or repair; revenue follows industrial output, vehicle repair volume and price, and licensing brings a small royalty stream.
businessLines.description: Industrial coatings for wood finishing and general industrial (metal and plastic) uses, automotive refinish, protective and marine coatings, coil coatings, packaging coatings, and performance-based resins and colorants, sold worldwide; licenses technology and trade names.

operatingProfit.note: Segment profit; FY2024 $1,027.9M (-8.3%), margin 15.1%. Net sales flat. H1 2026 net sales $3,619.6M vs $3,403.1M.

brands.name: Valspar, Dutch Boy, Minwax, Krylon, Purdy, Ronseal, Suvinil, Thompson's WaterSeal, Cabot, Geocel, Dupli-Color, HGTV HOME by Sherwin-Williams
brands.share: 13.4% of FY2025 net sales; brand-level sales not disclosed

brands.name: Suvinil (Brazil)
brands.share: Acquired October 2025; annual sales of about $525M per the 10-K
